v: 26.8.2-1 and 26.8.2-2 container images (x86-64); any distribution on an unpatched Java 17.0.6+, 21 or 25
n: Keycloak's official images bundle OpenJDK 21.0.13 and are affected on hosts with AVX-512 VBMI. No fixed image yet; Keycloak recommends turning off the JVM's Base64 intrinsics (-XX:-UseBASE64Intrinsics via JAVA_OPTS_APPEND) and checking the running JVM's flags.

Calif, which found Java4Shell, demonstrated remote code execution without logging in, in a default configuration, when the product runs on an affected Java build on an AVX-512 VBMI CPU. Keycloak's own advisory has the bundled runtime and workaround.
The Operator image bundles OpenJDK 25. Keycloak found no unauthenticated path to it but recommends the same -XX:-UseBASE64Intrinsics flag (JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS on the Operator deployment).
